Top-level quote: "We like the demo, but all new projects are frozen until next fiscal planning." — Head of Data Science (left to regulatory role 2025-12).

Key points: 
- Use-case: indexing legacy trial protocols + literature for faster cohort discovery. High sensitivity to PII, data residency.
- Target latency: 50-150ms per embed lookup for search surface; batches for re-ranking acceptable.
- Preferred models: quantized open models, possibility to bring customer-licensed LLMs; strong interest in private (VPC) deployment.
- Ops requirement: strict audit trails, KMS integration, 7+ year retention policies for certain trial artifacts.
